$comment: Structure-guard registries (spec 0009 §exceptions). Two registries with different jobs live here; web/eslint.config.mjs reads neither and switches no rule off by path. (1) `files` = the FILE-SIZE baseline: files above the hard line budget, read by scripts/check-file-size.mjs, only-shrink (a listed file may get smaller, never bigger). (2) `eslintSuppressions` = the BUDGET for the RULE-level registry in web/eslint-suppressions.json — that registry is what actually exempts code (ESLint bulk suppressions), and scripts/check-suppressions.mjs enforces it: any growth (new file, new rule, per-rule count +1) fails, entries whose rule no longer fires must be pruned, and the set of files carrying a `max-lines` suppression must equal (1). Adding or removing an exemption therefore edits both files in the same commit and shows up in review.
